title: Area of Hölder curves and coarea formula on the Heisenberg group
summary: We prove the coarea formula for Lipschitz maps from the subriemannian $n$th Heisenberg group $\mathbb H_n$ to $\mathbb R^{2n}$. Our result is new even when $n=1$ and provides the simplest vector-valued instance of the coarea formula in subriemannian geometry. This answers a question left open in the works of Magnani, Kozhevnikov, Magnani--Stepanov--Trevisan, and Julia--Nicolussi Golo--Vittone. The main difficulty of the proof is that a fiber of a $C^1_{\mathrm{H}}$ map $f: \mathbb H_n\to \mathbb R^{2n}$ is typically an unrectifiable curve.
